Name: MFL UID
Description: DHIS2 organisation unit UID of this location in the MOH Master Facility List. The key the MFL sync matches on

Name: MFL Code
Description: MOH facility code from the Master Facility List. Informational; never a key

Name: Facility Type
Description: Facility type from the Master Facility List

Name: Facility Ownership
Description: Facility ownership from the Master Facility List

Name: EmONC Level
Description: Emergency obstetric and newborn care level from the Master Facility List

Name: Facility Setting
Description: Rural or urban setting from the Master Facility List

Name: MFL Closed Date
Description: Date the Master Facility List records this facility as closed

Name: MFL Last Updated
Description: ISO-8601 lastUpdated of the MFL organisation unit at the last sync. Diagnostics only
